description: Estimate personal income tax and take-home pay from gross annual income for 57 countries, using the engine's effective-dated brackets with each country's own levies, offsets and social contributions as its scheme defines them. Covered: AE, AR, AT, AU, BD, BE, BR, CA, CH, CL, CN, CO, CR, CZ, DE, DK, EE, EG, ES, FI, FR, GB, GR, GT, HU, ID, IE, IL, IN, IS, IT, JM, JP, KE, KR, LU, LV, MX, MY, NG, NL, NO, NZ, PH, PK, PL, PT, SA, SE, SG, SI, SK, TH, TR, US, VN, ZA. Any other country returns 'not covered' rather than a guess; its headline rates live in tax_rate_lookup. Pass region for a state, province or nation where the scheme has one (CA: 13 regions, e.g. AB, BC, MB; ES: 3 regions, e.g. AN, CT, MD; GB: SCT (Scotland); US: 51 regions, e.g. AK, AL, AR); without it the answer is national only and says so in its assumptions. For Finland pass `municipality` (Finnish or Swedish name, e.g. 'Tampere' or 'Helsingfors') for that municipality's own rate — otherwise the national average is used and the answer says so — plus `church` for a parish member and `age` where it changes the contributions; Finland also returns the tax-card rate (veroprosentti). The figure is for EMPLOYMENT income (salary or wages) wherever a country applies an employee-only item — India's salary standard deduction, UK Class 1 National Insurance, US FICA — and the first assumption says so. For freelance or self-employed profit pass incomeType "self-employed": India and the UK compute it, countries where it is taxed the same answer it, and the rest refuse with what differs rather than return a salaried figure. This is a resident-individual estimate, not a filing calculation: relay the assumptions it returns. Each answer cites the income-tax source and date for that country — not the GST/VAT one. For AU HELP/HECS use student_loan_repayment. Results may include one sourced background fact (relatedFact); the figures do not depend on it.

age.description: Finland only: age at the end of the tax year. Changes the employee pension and unemployment contributions and, from 66, the earned-income credit; omit to assume a working age (18–64 from 2026, when the 53–62 pension surcharge ended; 18–52 for 2025)

church.description: Finland only: parish membership, for church tax. Needs `municipality`, because each parish sets its own rate

country.description: 2-letter ISO code of a covered country (upper case)

income.description: Gross annual income in local currency, before tax

incomeType.description: What the income is: "employment" (salary or wages, the default) or "self-employed" (freelance or sole-trader profit after business expenses). Countries that do not model self-employed income refuse it with what differs instead of returning the employment figure

municipality.description: Finland only: the municipality (kunta) of residence on 31 December of the previous year, in Finnish or Swedish, e.g. 'Helsinki', 'Espoo', 'Tampere', 'Åbo'. Sets the municipal and parish tax rates; omit to use the national average municipal rate

region.description: Optional state, province or nation code, where the country's scheme has one: CA: 13 regions, e.g. AB, BC, MB; ES: 3 regions, e.g. AN, CT, MD; GB: SCT (Scotland); US: 51 regions, e.g. AK, AL, AR

taxYear.description: Tax year as people write it, e.g. '2026-27' or '2026/27' (AU/NZ/GB/IN), '2026' (calendar-year countries), 'YA 2027' (Singapore), 'Tax Year 2027' (Pakistan, which names a year by its end); omit for the current tax year. A year not on file is refused with the years on file

name: income_tax_estimate

assumptions.description: Assumptions the figures depend on — relay them with the numbers; the first is always the income basis

averageRate.description: Total tax over gross, as a fraction

churchRate.description: Finland: church-tax rate applied, as a fraction (0 for a non-member)

dataVerifiedOn.description: ISO date the rate data was last confirmed against the authority

disclaimer.description: General-information note that must accompany any figure shown to a person

incomeBasis.description: What income the figure was computed for: employment (employee-only items applied), self-employed, or any (nothing depends on the income type). The first assumption says the same in words

incomeTax.description: Income tax before levies and offsets

levies.description: Charges on top of the offset tax, by name (social contributions, regional tax) — empty array when none apply

lito.description: Kept for compatibility: AU Low Income Tax Offset only, 0 for every other country. See `offsets` for the general figure.

marginalRate.description: Marginal rate on the next unit of income, as a fraction

mayBeStale.description: True once the verification date is over a year old — re-confirm with the authority

medicareLevy.description: Kept for compatibility: AU Medicare levy only, 0 for every other country. See `levies` for the general figure.

municipalRate.description: Finland: municipal income-tax rate applied, as a fraction

municipality.description: Finland: the municipality whose rates were used, or "national average"

offsets.description: Credits that reduced the tax, by name — empty array when none apply

region.description: State, province or nation whose tax was included — present only when region was passed

relatedFact.description: One sourced background fact about the country's income tax; the figures do not depend on it. Absent when no sourced fact fits.

context.description: Present on a state or provincial answer: the fact is about the country as a whole

country.description: 2-letter ISO code of the country the fact is about

detail.description: Longer supporting detail, when the corpus has it

fact.description: The fact, in one or two sentences

kind.description: 'origin' = when the tax began and what it replaced; 'anniversary' = the same, on the anniversary of its start date; 'story' = a dated story from the facts corpus

more.description: The tool that returns the full sourced fact set for this country

sourceName.description: Who the fact is sourced to

sourceUrl.description: Link to that source — always present

topic.description: Which tax the fact is about

verifiedDate.description: ISO date the fact was last checked against its source, when recorded

separatelyWithheld.description: Finland: employee pension and unemployment contributions for the year, to the cent — withheld by the employer on top of the tax card

source.description: The national tax authority the figures were verified against (e.g. 'ATO — ato.gov.au')

sourceUrl.description: https link to the authority page the rate was verified against. Present only on rate answers backed by a verified ledger row — absent (never empty) otherwise, so its presence is itself the claim

taxCardRate.description: Finland: the withholding percentage (veroprosentti) Vero would put on the tax card — rounded up to the next half point. Employee pension and unemployment contributions are withheld on top of it

taxCardWithheld.description: Finland: the tax the tax card covers for the year, to the cent (state, municipal, church, health insurance and YLE tax, less the credit)

taxYear.description: Tax year the brackets belong to

taxable.description: Income after any pre-band deduction (UK personal allowance, IN standard deduction, US standard deduction)

totalTax.description: Total tax after levies and offsets

title: Income tax & take-home estimate (57 countries)
